admissionRule: One exact documented name or explicit source alias, the same state and party, a unique Bioguide identity, an existing pinned image blob, and an explicit corpus public-domain declaration. No fuzzy name or facial matching. Photo identity does not certify nomination or ballot eligibility. Reviewed supplements may add exact identities from the same pinned historical CSV and official public-domain images captured from Wikimedia Commons; local image bytes and source revisions are verified before admission. Existing photos are never replaced by a supplement. Non-Congress candidates use an explicit FEC_CANDIDATE identity, exact source-candidate/contest binding and captured first-party name/state/party evidence; Commons public-domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA images require their exact revision, source hash, creator attribution and license. Existing 397 congressional portraits are preserved. FEC registration does not certify ballot eligibility.

identity.description: Community-maintained crosswalk of congressional names, states, parties and official Bioguide identifiers. This is an identity source, not certification of the election roster.
identity.hashNormalization: UTF-8, CRLF normalized to LF, one final LF

photos.rightsBasis: The source repository describes its congressional portraits as public domain, cites GPO's assurance for its Member Guide photos, and requires contributed photos to be official and public domain.

historical.description: Eleven reviewed former members whose documented name, state, party and Bioguide identity exactly match current source-listed candidates. Identity only; not ballot certification. Historical-name matches are individually reviewed to exclude unrelated deceased namesakes.
